# ImageIO

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 38.1% of Apple's iOS API (332 of 871, exact) · **Rows:** 6: 2 ✅ 3 🟡 1 ❌ · **iOS:** 4.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Graphics & text](../COVERAGE.md#graphics) · **Apple:** [ImageIO](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/imageio) · **Issues:** [`area:graphics`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Agraphics)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** `isim/frameworks/ImageIO/ImageIO.m`. Decoding uses gdk-pixbuf; HEIC uses isim's own reader and writer (x265).

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| ImageIO `CGImageSource` (types, count, properties, frames, thumbnails, EXIF orientation) | 🟡 | ≤17 | PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP/TIFF/ICO via gdk-pixbuf; GIF delays/loop count; thumbnails with max size and orientation transform; tested (HelloImaging). HEIC through isim's HEIF reader (tested: host test), AVIF through the host's ffmpeg (unverified); incremental sources unverified. Missing: properties are size, orientation, alpha and a fixed depth (8) and DPI (72): no EXIF, GPS or IPTC dictionaries |
| ImageIO `CGImageDestination` (PNG, JPEG, animated GIF, HEIC) | 🟡 | ≤17 | GIF palette: exact up to 255 colors, else a color cube; tested (HelloImaging). HEIC with the host's ffmpeg libx265 (isim's HEIF writer; listed only when available); other types (TIFF) are refused. Missing: metadata (EXIF, GPS, orientation) is not written, so `AddImageFromSource` drops it |
| Image metadata in properties (`CGImageSourceCopyPropertiesAtIndex`): `kCGImagePropertyTIFFDictionary`, `kCGImagePropertyExifDictionary`, `kCGImagePropertyGPSDictionary`, `kCGImagePropertyIPTCDictionary` and their keys (`CGImagePropertyKeys.h`) | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim reads the TIFF IFDs itself (a JPEG's APP1 Exif, a PNG's eXIf, a WebP's EXIF chunk, a TIFF file's IFD0) and IPTC-IIM (a JPEG's APP13 Photoshop resource 0x0404); values as ImageIO gives them (rationals as numbers, GPS coordinates in degrees with their references, versions and ISO ratings as arrays); the DPI from the resolution tags; tested (ImageIOTest over fixtures Pillow wrote, HelloImaging) |
| `CGImageMetadata`, `CGMutableImageMetadata`, `CGImageMetadataTag` (create, copy, tags, paths, string values, set / remove, namespaces, enumeration, `CGImageMetadataCreateXMPData` / `CreateFromXMPData`, `CopyTagMatchingImageProperty` / `SetValueMatchingImageProperty`), `CGImageSourceCopyMetadataAtIndex` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: isim's own XMP model; packets read with NSXMLParser (simple, Bag, Seq, Alt and language alternatives, structures by parseType or nested descriptions, attribute properties) and written by isim; a source's metadata is its XMP packet plus its EXIF / TIFF / GPS / IPTC in their XMP names (exif, exifEX, tiff, dc, photoshop, Iptc4xmpCore: rationals as "n/d", ISO 8601 dates, "DDD,MM.mmmmK" coordinates); the packet's own tags win; tested (ImageIOTest, HelloImaging) |
| Writing metadata: properties given to `CGImageDestinationAddImage` / `SetProperties`, `CGImageDestinationAddImageFromSource` (keeps the source's), `CGImageDestinationAddImageAndMetadata`, `CGImageDestinationCopyImageSource` (`kCGImageDestinationMetadata`, `MergeMetadata`, `DateTime`, `Orientation`, `kCGImageMetadataShouldExcludeXMP` / `GPS`) | 🟡 | ≤17 | adapted: JPEG gets APP1 Exif (big-endian TIFF), APP1 XMP and APP13 IPTC; PNG gets eXIf and an iTXt XMP packet (IPTC only through XMP); metadata maps to EXIF where its tags do; `CopyImageSource` rewrites a JPEG's or PNG's metadata and copies the image data as it is; tested (ImageIOTest; the JPEG it writes is checked by Pillow). Missing: GIF and HEIC destinations write no metadata; HEIC sources' EXIF is not read; maker notes and extended XMP are left out |
| `CGAnimateImageDataWithBlock`, `CGAnimateImageAtURLWithBlock`, `CGImageAnimationStatus`, `CGImageSourceAnimationBlock`, `kCGImageAnimationStartIndex` / `DelayTime` / `LoopCount` | ✅ | 13.0 | *adapted*: the frames of GIF and animated WebP images (any other image is one frame) decoded through a `CGImageSource` and handed to the block on the main queue, each after its `DelayTime` (or the option's), for the file's loop count (0 is forever) or the option's, until the block sets `stop`; unknown data gives `unsupportedFormat`, a start index past the frames `parameterError`; tested (`tests/imageio`, test_imageio) |
| Animation properties: `kCGImagePropertyGIFFrameInfoArray` / `CanvasPixelWidth` / `CanvasPixelHeight`, the same `WebP` keys; `APNG` and `HEICS` keys declared | 🟡 | 13.0 | *adapted*: GIF and WebP files report each frame's delays and the canvas; tested (`tests/imageio`). isim decodes no animated PNG or HEICS sequences, so their keys never appear |
| `CGImageSourceCreateIncremental`, `CGImageSourceUpdateData` / `UpdateDataProvider`, `CGImageSourceRemoveCacheAtIndex`, `CGImageSourceSetAllowableTypes` | ✅ | ≤17 | *adapted*: before the last data the source reports the images that already decode, with status incomplete; a type outside the allowable ones gives a source with no images (unknown type); tested (`tests/imageio`) |
| Auxiliary data: `CGImageSourceCopyAuxiliaryDataInfoAtIndex`, `CGImageDestinationAddAuxiliaryDataInfo`, `kCGImageAuxiliaryDataType*` (depth, disparity, portrait effects and semantic segmentation mattes, HDR / ISO gain maps), `kCGImageAuxiliaryDataInfo*`, `kCGImagePropertyAuxiliaryData` / `Width` / `Height` / `BytesPerRow` / `PixelFormat` | 🟡 | ≤17 | *adapted*, JPEG only: each is a Multi-Picture Format image after the primary one, an 8-bit JPEG whose XMP (`http://ns.apple.com/pixeldatainfo/1.0/`) gives its type, native pixel format and value range; float formats (`hdis`, `fdis`, `hdep`, `fdep`, `L00h`, `L00f`) are stored in 8 bits within that range, `L008` / `L016` / `BGRA` / `RGBA` too; the info's metadata is kept. isim's own encoding: not checked against iPhone files. HEIC auxiliary images and `kCGImageAuxiliaryDataInfoColorSpace` are not read; tested (`tests/imageio`, Pillow reads the MPF images) |
| `CGImagePropertyTGACompression`, `IMAGEIO_PNG_*` filter flags, `IIO_HAS_IOSURFACE` | 🟡 | ≤17 | declared as in Apple's SDK; isim reads no TGA and its PNG encoder picks its own filters |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `CGMutableImageMetadata` (with its members under "Not yet in isim") |
